claims.text: The manual says not to exceed the maximum payload defined in the Genuine Motorcycle Accessories (GMA) fitting instructions for panniers and top boxes.

The manual does not give a kilogram figure for the panniers or top box. That value is in the separate GMA fitting instructions, which are not part of this manual, so I can't state it. Check those instructions for your luggage.

unanswered_parts: Maximum payload in kilograms for the panniers and top box
